name: Gasolineras de España
author: hullcode

sections.description:
Gasolineras de España is a flexible and easy-to-use plugin that allows you to display a beautiful gas station widget in your website without any coding skills.

Create a widget, select any location within Spain, choose the data and customize the look and feel with a few clicks.

KEY FEATURES

  • 11000 spanish gas stations available updated every hour.
  • Gas station info with current prices, distance, location and link to GPS.
  • Display up to 25 gas stations.
  • Order by distance or prices.
  • Fully responsive & mobile friendly.
  • Easy to use – No coding required.
  • Shortcodes.
  • Fully customizable. You can show or hide every element.
  • Widget can be styled individually. Choose font color, background, etc.
  • Translatable .pot file.
  • Fast: the widget is rendered on your server with the data already in the page, no JavaScript needed.
  • Prices are cached in your WordPress for 30 minutes.

Gasolineras de España is a service provided by mejorgasolinera.com

External services

This plugin gets gas station data and prices from the mejorgasolinera.com service.

  • What is sent and when: when a page with the widget or the shortcode is shown and the cached data is older than 30 minutes, your server sends the configured latitude and longitude, your site’s domain name and the plugin version to https://mejorgasolinera.com/api/gas/gasstations. When you type an address in the widget settings, your server sends that text to https://mejorgasolinera.com/api/gas/coordinates. Requests are made by your server: your visitors’ browsers and IP addresses are never sent to mejorgasolinera.com.
  • Brand icons are included in the plugin and served from your site.
  • Terms and privacy: Legal notice, Privacy policy.
sections.installation:
Manual installation

  • Download the zip file and extract the content
  • Upload the folder gasolineras-de-espana to your WP plugin folder /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  • Go to Plugins > Plugins, and activate the plugin

Widget

  • Go to Appearance > Widgets, and drag the widget to a sidebar
  • Configure your widget

Shortcode

  • Go to Appearance > Widgets, and drag the widget to a sidebar
  • Configure your widget
  • Copy the shortcode generated at bottom
  • Remove widget
  • Paste shortcode wherever you want
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • The widget is rendered on the server: no JavaScript on your pages and no empty boxes while loading.
  • Data is requested by your server and cached in WordPress for 30 minutes. If the service is down, the last data is shown.
  • Your visitors’ IP addresses are no longer sent to mejorgasolinera.com.
  • Brand icons for 80 more brands.
  • Fixed: GA+ showed the diesel price.
  • Shortcode attributes are validated.
